digest.component_or_area: review-bot reconciliation and retrigger acceptance paths
propositions: /rerun and recheck-review requests are represented only as fire-and-forget events in a process-local asyncio queue; if the receiver exits before the event is processed, the request is lost and cannot be recovered from durable state
Reconciliation skips revisions that have a nonzero Gerrit vote and a matching local voted row, even after process loss invalidates the in-memory forced event

The approved solution resets the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review: 0 before acknowledging acceptance, causing Gerrit to emit a fresh comment-added event with patchSet metadata that serves as the durable marker for reconciliation

Reconciliation must query Gerrit before checking local dedup; a successful no-nonzero-vote read calls clear_voted to clean stale dedup, while a Gerrit read error preserves dedup and holds the cursor back
The reset operation must verify that all accounts retain no nonzero vote after reset; a surviving concurrent or admin vote is fail-closed and causes the acceptance to be rejected
Contributor text cannot influence the reset label value or mint PASS/BLOCK votes; only the fixed neutral reset (0) is applied, and affirmative replies remain label-free
